subject.title: [Bug]: Slash command error——WebUI treats `/model status` as a model name instead of a slash-command subcommand

question: Should maintainers treat the open cross-repo closing PR as the canonical fix path, or allow a new narrow OpenClaw fix PR for this issue?
rationale: The source-level bug is clear, but the only open closing PR is not in the target repository, is not maintainer-modifiable, and repeats a same-repository approach that was closed as too broad.

options.title: Resolve linked PR, then queue replacement
options.body: Mark the cross-repo PR non-canonical unless it is resubmitted upstream with corrected semantics, then allow a narrow current-main fix for this issue.

options.title: Ask the fork author to resubmit
options.body: Keep this issue paired to the existing fork PR and ask the author to open a corrected upstream PR with real Control UI proof.

options.title: Keep parked behind the fork PR
options.body: Leave the issue open but do not queue replacement work until the cross-repo PR is closed or updated.

recommendation.title: Resolve linked PR, then queue replacement
recommendation.body: Mark the cross-repo PR non-canonical unless it is resubmitted upstream with corrected semantics, then allow a narrow current-main fix for this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete recently maintained this Control UI model-command path and already handled the stale sibling PR for this issue.
